xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #3425

plan.title: Agents in a shared product must inherit assumed project knowledge

narratives.Description: Isolated agents do not inherit authored project invariants, so they can break sibling contracts. First ship is a typed plan.policy.projectInvariants list plus coverage_map dispositions and a preflight fail-closed on missing applicable IDs.
narratives.UserStory: As a swarm parent, I want every story to declare how it treats applicable project invariants, so that a slice cannot ship without naming the contracts it must not break.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Story A schema. Story B+C gate and docs. Close-time file five parked issues.
narratives.Overview: Pass-1 first slice: typed projectInvariants plus preflight fail-closed. Parked items filed as follow-up issues.
narratives.CurrentShape: Pass-1 locked. Story A merged PR 3441. Story B+C merged PR 3442. Parked 3443-3447.

items.title: Story A: typed plan.policy.projectInvariants + coverage_map reuse + applicability intersection

narrative.Acceptance: Given PROJECT-DEFINITION, when plan.policy.projectInvariants is parsed, each entry has id, statement, and contract surface. Empty or absent list is valid. Scope coverage_map reuses covered/deferred/behavioral_delta against those ids. Given a scope file_scope with no intersection, when applicability is computed then no disposition is required.

items.title: Story B+C: preflight/story-ready fail-closed + docs and Visage examples

narrative.Acceptance: Given an applicable invariant with no disposition, the implementation-intent gate and story-start gate fail closed and name the omitted id. An id added after authoring fails at the next gate. Docs state the honesty limit. Visage entries are authored examples only.

items.title: Close-time: file five parked follow-up issues with Refs #3425

narrative.Acceptance: Given parent scope:complete, when #3425 is closed then five parked items exist as separate GitHub issues with Refs #3425 and their numbers are listed on the close comment.

references.title: Issue #3425: Agents in a shared product must inherit assumed project knowledge

swarm.acceptance_criteria_justification: Locked pass-1 has 7 body ACs sequenced as Story A (schema) then Story B+C (gate+docs) plus a close-time parked-issue checklist from the decomposition comment.
